messages:
maria: FYI we've got a reproducible parse-failure pattern from the raven-lite quant canary. ~2.9% of streaming funcall sessions have non-JSON interjections that break our ndjson reader.
ravi: can you show a raw snippet?
maria: pasted from capture: 
```
{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"redwood p99"}}
thinking... expanding synonyms
{"tool":"filter","args":{"k":"env","v":"prod"}}
```
maria: reader expects one JSON obj per line, so the plain-text line causes parse error.
aj: interesting — we've seen truncated braces and streaming splits before, but inline commentary is new. is this correlated with the quantized variant?
maria: yes, quantized instances show higher frequency but non-quantized also hit occasionally. seems model adds short meta comments.
sam: we should NOT silently drop content without audit. downstream logic sometimes relies on extra fields or "notes" keys.
ravi: design suggestion: implement a non-destructive postprocess flow: (1) detect non-JSON lines, (2) attempt bounded repairs, (3) route original unmodified stream to mirror storage for later analysis. emit structured telemetry.
aj: propose lightweight heuristics first: drop empty lines, drop lines matching ^(note|thinking|debug|edit)[:\- ] case-insensitive, and small-merge up to 2 adjacent lines if that yields parsable JSON. keep merge window small. pseudo: 
```python
lines = s.splitlines()
out = []
for i,line in enumerate(lines):
  if looks_like_json(line): out.append(line); continue
  if re.match(r'^(note|thinking|debug|edit)[:\- ]', line, re.I): telemetry.record('dropped', line); continue
  merged = line
  for j in range(1,3):
    merged += '\n' + lines[i+j]
    if looks_like_json(merged): out.append(merged); telemetry.record('merged', i); break
```
aj: important to bound j and ensure we don't combine unrelated objects.
sam: telemetry fields: repair_action (dropped/merged/failed), original_snippet_id, position_in_stream, model_variant. Also save raw snippet to S3 with 30d TTL. create an alert if repair_rate > 1% of traffic.
ravi: need an evaluation plan before enabling in prod — A/B canary: 50% pass-through (raw), 50% postprocess. Collect metrics: parse_fail_rate, funcall_success_rate, schema_rejection_rate, semantic-fidelity score (field-level diffs). 5k samples per arm min.\maria: I'll collect a labeled sample set (200 annotated failures) to help tune repair heuristics so we don't remove legit fields like "notes": "...".
aj: implement feature flags: enable_interjection_strip and enable_stream_mirror, both default off. keep mirrors immutable.
sam: automation: fail the canary if stripped arm shows >0.5% reduction in funcall_success relative to raw. also compare important field-presence rates.
ravi: for semantic checks we'll run golden prompts through both arms and compute tokenized similarity for each structured field and run schema validators. report delta per-field; escalate if any field drops >1%.
anmaria: typo — meant maria: also consider token-level prompting nudge later if patterns persist; for now handle in postprocess.
canary-bot: scheduled rollout: raven-lite-quant v3 split 50/50 at 2025-12-02T14:00Z (job: cny-9082).
canary-bot: initial metrics (first 1800 reqs): parse_fail_rate(raw)=2.92%, parse_fail_rate(stripped)=0.74%, repair_actions: dropped=1.6%, merged=0.25%, failed_repair=0.06%.
sam: promising but need the A/B semantic diffs (ravi).
ravi: kicking off eval harness now, will post field-diff summary and any suspect examples in this thread.
maria: thanks — I'll upload the annotated corpus to #eng-ml and link it here for tuning. keeping thread for follow-ups. :thumbsup
